target_applications: 3C/electronics assembly, automotive parts assembly, logistics sorting, commercial interaction, embodied-AI data collection

base_type.value: wheeled (4-DoF omnidirectional chassis: omni, crab-walk, in-place rotation)

dof_total.source: https://www.agibot.com/products/G2 (active DoF: 3 neck + 2x7 arms + 5 waist/leg + 4 chassis; hands excluded)

payload_total_kg.source: 2x5kg rated; dual-arm total not separately stated

torso_lift.value: 3-DOF waist (roll/pitch/yaw; yaw ±174.5°, pitch -110°..+64°) + 2-DOF folding/lifting leg (knee 0-152°), 570mm height range (1225-1795mm); 3-DOF neck
torso_lift.source: https://www.agibot.com/public/static/index/en/images/G2/G2Four-img.jpg (official anatomy diagram) + official G2 spec PDF

actuators.value: electric joints with full-arm torque sensors; 'cross-wrist' force-controlled arm; ~0.5N force control resolution

end_effector.value: quick-swap end-effectors: optional 19-DOF dexterous hand (O12) w/ 3D tactile, OmniPicker; grippers standard

sensors_head.value: RGB-D camera, stereo camera, fisheye camera array (360°), interactive display, microphone array (sound-source localization), 8W speaker

sensors_wrist_hand.value: wrist RGB-D cameras; full joint torque sensing; optional dexterous hand with 3D tactile sensing

compute.value: NVIDIA Jetson Thor T5000, 2070 TFLOPS (FP4), <10ms latency claim
compute.source: https://www.agibot.com/public/static/index/en/images/G2/G2Four-img.jpg (official anatomy diagram) + official G2 spec PDF

software_stack.value: GO-1/GO-2 VLA models; collect-train-deploy data flywheel (AgiBot World); AimRT middleware; OTA; secondary development supported; Wi-Fi/BT/4G/5G/NFC; closed source + B2B SDK

safety_compliance.value: IP42 body / IP50 arms; automotive-grade components; torque-sensing compliance; no published third-party certification

price.value: not disclosed; predecessor Genie G1 at RMB 450k (~USD 62k)
